name: universal-debugger
description: Cross-codebase debugging orchestration for routing failures, bug hunts, adjacent defect sweeps, and evidence-backed fixes.

interface.shortDescription: Route debugging work through root-cause-first investigation workflows.
interface.longDescription: Portable Codex plugin for diagnosing issues across codebases by collecting evidence, choosing the right debugging skill family, preserving root-cause-first investigation, finding same-family bugs during approved fixes, and producing clear handoffs before fixes.
defaultPrompt: Diagnose this failure and identify the root cause before fixing it.
Find real bugs in this diff and sweep for adjacent defects while fixing.
Turn these logs and symptoms into an evidence-backed debugging handoff.
